description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeAttachment entity in an HRM system using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models attachments associated with employees, including details like filename, size, file type, description, and metadata such as who attached the file and when. It also categorizes different screens or sections where attachments might be used.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachment
classes.description: Represents an employee's attachment, including file details, categorization, and metadata such as who added it and when. Uses traits for decorator and DateTime helper functionalities. Contains constants for different screens or contexts where attachments are relevant.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the associated Employee object.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the associated Employee object.

methods.name: getAttachId
methods.description: Returns the attachment's unique identifier within the employee context.

methods.name: setAttachId
methods.description: Sets the attachment's unique identifier.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Retrieves the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment in bytes.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the raw attachment data (resource or string).

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets the attachment data.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type or file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen/category where the attachment is used.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Sets the screen/category for the attachment. Validates allowed screens.

methods.name: getAttachedBy
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedBy
methods.description: Sets the ID of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedByName
methods.description: Returns the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setAttachedByName
methods.description: Sets the name of the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedTime
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setAttachedTime
methods.description: Sets the DateTime when the attachment was added.
